claim.supported_scope: Comparison of exactly two converged admissible cbsem_ml_v1 models on identical complete cases and observed variables: ordinary-ML likelihood-ratio testing for verified nested pairs, or descriptive AIC/BIC deltas for explicitly non-nested pairs.
claim.estimand: For nested models, the restricted-minus-unrestricted chi-square and degrees-of-freedom differences; for non-nested models, A-minus-B AIC and BIC differences without a significance test.
assumptions: Both models use the same dataset fingerprint, exact retained row identities, observed-variable order, ML discrepancy, and preprocessing.
A nested declaration is mechanically verified as fixed or equality constraints on the unrestricted parameterization.
Both fits converge to finite admissible solutions with positive comparison degrees of freedom where a likelihood-ratio test is requested.
exclusions: More than two models, different cases or variables, unverified nesting, robust or ordinal estimators, boundary-parameter mixtures, and automatic search are excluded.
No significance test is emitted for non-nested models.
A lower criterion or significant difference does not prove that the favored model is true.
warnings: Likelihood-ratio inference is valid only for the verified nested ordinary-ML scope.
AIC/BIC comparisons are conditional on identical data and likelihood conventions and should be interpreted with theory and diagnostics.

equations.expression: Delta_chi2 = chi2_restricted - chi2_unrestricted; Delta_df = df_restricted - df_unrestricted

references.citation: Satorra and Bentler (2001), A Scaled Difference Chi-Square Test Statistic for Moment Structure Analysis, DOI 10.1007/BF02296192; v1 uses its ordinary-ML nested special case only
Akaike (1974), A New Look at the Statistical Model Identification, DOI 10.1109/TAC.1974.1100705
Schwarz (1978), Estimating the Dimension of a Model, DOI 10.1214/aos/1176344136
Independent Python nesting validator and ML difference/AIC/BIC reference

simulations.design: Verified nested CFA and recursive SEM pairs under null and alternative constraints across sample size, loading/path magnitude, and covariance conditions.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed data-generation seeds; both models use identical generated samples and deterministic fits.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The null rejection interval must contain nominal alpha, power and numerical agreement must meet preregistered limits, and any invalid nesting must be blocked.

simulations.design: Non-nested pairs with known relative Kullback-Leibler risk and equal-risk controls.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario and replicate seeds with deterministic fits.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Criterion calculations must match the independent reference and no non-nested case may emit a chi-square-difference p-value.

boundaries.case: Either model is nonconverged, non-finite, unidentified, or has an inadmissible variance.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Comparison is unavailable and no inferential preference is emitted.

boundaries.case: Models differ in cases, observed variables, estimator, preprocessing, exceed two candidates, or claim unverified nesting.
Non-nested model A and B are swapped.
boundaries.expected_behavior: AIC/BIC deltas reverse sign and magnitudes remain equal within tolerance.

boundaries.case: The same model pair and data execute repeatedly.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Nesting decision, fits, deltas, p-value availability, and diagnostics are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: A model checksum, row set, nesting declaration, fit, parameter count, delta, p-value, or method identity is changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose identity differs from CB-SEM model comparison.
Reject a comparison relabeled as another version.
Reject either candidate when its dataset or retained-row identity differs.
Reject an archive entry whose candidate or comparison checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid nesting, non-finite fits, inconsistent degrees of freedom, or a non-nested p-value.
Never reinterpret descriptive saved-run comparison as CB-SEM analytical comparison v1.

persistence.legacy_policy: Historical side-by-side CB-SEM results remain descriptive and cannot satisfy this contract.

applicability_blockers: Different data, rows, variables, estimator, or preprocessing
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must produce the same nesting validation, fits, criterion deltas, inference availability, and diagnostics for identical inputs.
accessibility_rules: Every fit or comparison visual has an equivalent accessible table.
Direction, unavailable tests, and warnings are exposed without color alone.
